channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Grounding the Cloud 2026
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-grounding-the-cloud
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 30,000 per grant. No application fee.
  • Kone Foundation: Annual Grant Call (2026)
    https://koneensaatio.fi/en/grants/grantapplicants/criteria-for-applying/
    Kone Foundation / Koneen Saatio (Finland) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Artistic groups and organisations up to EUR 250,000; research groups typically EUR 200,000 to 500,000. Minimum project duration six months for individual applicants and one month for groups; maximum four consecutive years for the same project. No co-financing requirement stated. No application fee. No retroactive funding.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• British Council Ireland: UK-IRL Culture Connects Grant 2026/27
    https://www.britishcouncil.ie/programmes/arts/uk-irl-culture-connects-grant-202627
    British Council Ireland / Arts Council Ireland · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · Up to EUR 3,000 per collaboration (smaller amounts also eligible), covering artist fees (including your own time), collaborator fees, travel and accommodation, studio or space hire, materials, and access costs including disability support. No application fee.
  • Rijkscultuurfondsen: Interdisciplinary Grant
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/interdisciplinary/
    Dutch national cultural funds (Rijkscultuurfondsen), via the Mondriaan Fund · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · EUR 12,500 to 50,000 per project. The individual-maker track is approximately EUR 24,900 for 12 months (income cap EUR 55,000 including the grant).

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Emergence Art+Science Fellowships: Open Call for New Commissions (Emergence Festival 2027)
    https://www.d-iep.org/artsciencefellowships
    Emergence at All Scales (EAAS), with The Science & Cocktails Foundation, Stichting Paradiso and NWA Route Kunst · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Production budget up to EUR 20,000 including VAT per project (covers artist fees, materials, equipment, space, travel, accommodation, installation and presentation). Total call budget EUR 80,000 (around four projects). No application fee.
  • (Perma)culture Open Call 2026 (Ceske Budejovice 2028 European Capital of Culture)
    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdTTlZOjtEvvtKrkisZxHKecf2flkMl27a7-NeEkRVswjHGuQ/viewform
    Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · Large projects: support up to CZK 4,000,000 (approx. EUR 160,000), min budget CZK 2,200,000, max 50% of total costs. Small projects: support up to CZK 1,500,000 (approx. EUR 60,000), min budget CZK 750,000, max 70% of total costs. Each project must include at least one international partner and at least one South Bohemian regional partner. Budget covers two years of preparation and implementation (2027 + 2028). No application fee.
